title: Tighter Controls and Real-time Anomaly Detection for SIM Card Purchases, Re-registration Patterns and GSM Gateway Misuse
what_it_is: Tighter Controls and Real-time Anomaly Detection for SIM Card Purchases, Re-registration Patterns and GSM Gateway Misuse

sections.label: SIM card limits and scam mules
sections.summary: Scam mules are barred from new mobile lines since 1 October 2025, and from 28 February 2026 each person is limited to 10 postpaid SIM cards across all telcos.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Since 1 October 2025, scam mules are barred from subscribing to new mobile lines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: From 28 February 2026, each person is limited to 10 postpaid SIM cards across all telecommunication companies (telcos), on top of the existing cap of three prepaid SIM cards per person across all telcos.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: In 2025, SPF disrupted more than 105,000 scam-related mobile lines across all telcos.

sections.label: Gateway device import approval
sections.summary: Gateway devices with five or more SIM card slots are prohibited without IMDA's prior approval for import since 1 February 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Gateway devices with five or more SIM card slots are prohibited without IMDA's prior approval for import since 1 February 2025.

sections.label: Penalties for supplying SIM cards
sections.summary: Mules who supply SIM cards to scammers may be liable for imprisonment of up to three years and caning of up to 12 strokes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Mules who supply SIM cards to scammers may be liable for imprisonment of up to three years and caning of up to 12 strokes.

sections.label: SMS first-contact cases decrease
sections.summary: Cases with SMS as the first contact method decreased about 65%, from 1,285 cases in 2024 to 450 cases in 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The number of cases with short message service (SMS) as the first contact method has also decreased about 65% – from 1,285 cases in 2024, to 450 cases in 2025.

sections.label: SIMCardHowMany checking tool
sections.summary: IMDA and GovTech jointly developed SIMCardHowMany, which lets mobile phone users check the number of postpaid SIM cards registered under their names.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: IMDA, together with GovTech, has jointly developed a new tool, SIMCardHowMany, you can Google it and look at it online, which allows mobile phone users to check the number of postpaid SIM cards currently registered under their names.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Persons who discover discrepancies or suspects that postpaid SIM cards have been fraudulently registered under their names should inform their telcos immediately.
